name: Laird's Response
summary: Along Teldrassil's shores, Laird's Response carries a puzzle for Nessa Shadowsong. The fish there are larger and more plentiful than those along mainland Darkshore.

sections.title: A Matter of Scales and Roots
sections.body: Laird compares catches from across the Veiled Sea. Fish from Teldrassil's coast are larger and more plentiful than those from Darkshore's mainland beaches. In his reply to Nessa Shadowsong, Laird of Auberdine offers a theory: the newly planted World Tree's unusual presence and vitality may be changing the surrounding sea life. Travelers carry his letter across the water to Rut'theran Village, where the fisherfolk greet the news with wonder and quiet curiosity.

faq.answer: Laird's Response is a dispatch from Laird, a fish merchant and curer in Auberdine, replying to Nessa Shadowsong's inquiry in Teldrassil.
Laird writes to Nessa Shadowsong, a night elf living in Rut'theran Village at Teldrassil's southern base.

faq.q: What does the letter say about the fish?
faq.answer: Laird writes that fish from Teldrassil's shores are larger and more plentiful than those from mainland Darkshore. He suspects the World Tree may influence the sea life nearby.

faq.q: How does the message travel back to Rut'theran Village?
aliases: how to get back to nessa
faq.answer: A carrier can take the regular ferry from Auberdine's docks or arrange a hippogryph flight with Caylais Moonfeather, the flight master.

angles.text: As a night elf tending Teldrassil's shores, you may find Laird's notes intriguing and a little unsettling: the young World Tree may already influence the nature around it.
